validation.scope: amount accounts independently reconstructed from zero positions and saved orders; actual accounts P&L/fees/metrics checked, not independent reconstruction from raw market and corporate actions

protocol.purpose: 当前冻结国盛月频版的实盘输入质量及固定周频/日频费用对照，不部署不下单
protocol.baseline: guosheng_final_decision_20261114/study.py; current R6 merged macro, corrected PMI and SHFE metals

frequency.weekly: ISO周首个可交易日；上一交易日数据；不搜索星期
frequency.daily: 每个交易日；上一交易日数据；每日重算篮子与63日ERC
frequency.month_and_switch: 原月初加篮子变化事件

protocol.cash: 卖款下一个交易日才可用于买入；日频每日按最新目标执行，不复用昨日过期目标
protocol.controls: 全部费用档比较同口径V12；长期另做严格FCF边界；长历史零费用仅作路径成本拖累诊断
protocol.statistics: 日历CAGR; sample std*sqrt252; include initial capital drawdown; annual one-way turnover=sum(notional/prior_nav)/2/years; normalized commission and slip separate
protocol.execution_scope: 长历史分数金额次收盘；近期实际开盘报价100份与1%滞后ADV；均非真实成交；每日监控不等于每日交易
protocol.data: 读取已归档输入；官方网站当前查询单列，不混入冻结回测
